notes.title: Change Log v1.2.2:
Change Log v1.2.2:
Change Log v1.2.1:
notes.content:
We at Cyber Rhino Studios are happy to announce: we have leaderboards! Now you can compete with your friends on Gryphon Knight Epic! See who gets more gold and who finishes each stage faster!

[h1] New Feature:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Leaderboards, each stage keeps your score for clear time and gold collected.
[/list]

[h1] Bug Fix:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Minor fix on the value of the combo multiplier displayed by the Dwarf squire;
[*]Fixed a bug that made the game crash if the player equipped the Fairy squire at the max level then changed to another squire before been defeated.
[/list]
